Fast-lane flag: ads would start before the sample is in hand (Dhruv's approved exception).

risks: 1) Price check: the same class of screen is $45 to $77 on Amazon, so a $119.99 kit needs a clear reason (camera, mounts, support, fit help), and LAMTTO's own 9 inch kit with camera is $139.99 before a 20 percent code. 2) Cost: the only non-promo US prices read are $44 to $55 on thin listings; the proven listings carry promo tags. On $54.99 the cost is well above the 35 percent guide at $119.99; only the $36.35 promo price comes near it. The script decides. 3) Electronics defects and 'sound through FM is poor' complaints (a carplaylife.com review of a LAMTTO unit notes weak FM transmission and slow connection; ESTIMATED, search snippet). 4) Returns from buyers who expected a factory-style install. 5) Unlicensed CarPlay implementation could stop working after an iOS update; sellers advertise OTA updates but that is unverified. 6) US listings can run out mid-test; name a second US listing before ads start.
